name: Heinz Homestyle Classic Savory Beef Gravy
whyItWorks: Rich, smooth brown beef gravy made with beef stock. It has zero gristle, zero seeds, and zero insoluble fiber, providing comforting savory richness without chewing fatigue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm and ladle over mashed potatoes or tender pot roast.
watchOuts: Low in fiber and residue; enjoy warm.
